|quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Bone Offering''' is an [[offering]] [[spell]] that consumes one or more [[corpse]]s, temporarily granting the player's [[minion]]s a chance to [[block]] [[attack]]s and [[spell]]s, and [[life]] [[regeneration]] if they have blocked [[recently]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== The skill consumes a corpse and up to 4 additional corpses around it. Each additional corpse extends the base duration of the skill by 1 second, making the maximum achievable base duration 9 seconds. Each player may only have one [[offering]] active at any time. Casting an Offering skill while one is already active will cancel the older one. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Block
